members.name: overscan
members.doc: The rows mounted above and below the visible window, an integer of 0 or more. For a grid they are whole grid rows.

members.name: items
members.doc: The rows of a stack layout, as strings or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, and `disabled`. Stack layout only: a grid takes its items on its GridList.

members.name: height
members.doc: The stack viewport's block size in px, a finite number greater than 0. Stack layout only.

members.name: itemHeight
members.doc: The fixed height of each stack row in px, a finite number greater than 0. Rows are not measured, so content taller than this overflows into the next row. Stack layout only.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every stack row and stops `onScroll`. Stack layout only: a grid disables its GridList instead.

members.name: onScroll
members.doc: Called when the stack viewport scrolls. It is not called while the Virtualizer is disabled. Stack layout only.

members.name: minItemWidth
members.doc: Minimum item width in px for a grid, a finite number greater than 0. Default 200.

members.name: maxItemWidth
members.doc: Maximum item width in px for a grid, Infinity or a finite number no smaller than `minItemWidth`. Default unbounded, so items stretch to fill their columns.

members.name: estimatedItemHeight
members.doc: Estimated height in px of the grid rows that have not mounted yet, a finite number greater than 0. Default 200. Mounted rows take their measured content height.

members.name: maxColumns
members.doc: Cap on the number of grid columns, Infinity or an integer greater than 0. Default unbounded. A narrow container shows fewer.

members.name: value

members.name: layout
members.doc: `stack`, the default, is a fixed-row list that renders its own items. `grid` wraps one GridList that has layout="grid" and the vertical orientation, and lays it out in measured rows.
